title: Quick World Reboot (QWR)
description: Quick World Reboot teleports all players to a set world, deletes and recreates the current world, and resets the adventure instantly.

# 🌍 Quick World Reboot

> **Fast • Safe • Simple World Resets for Minecraft Servers ⚡**

![QWR Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2e212ddf77ee3b52199e3b3de043cf67892f7871_0.webp)

Quick World Reboot (**QWR**) is a lightweight yet powerful Minecraft plugin that allows you to completely reset Minecraft worlds with a single command.

Perfect for SMPs, challenge servers, practice servers, temporary event worlds, minigames, and more.

---

# ✨ Features

## 🌎 Instant World Resets
Delete and recreate worlds automatically within seconds.

✅ Full support for **Multiverse-Core 5.x** and its modern **Options-API**.

---

## 👥 Safe Player Handling
Automatically teleports all players from the target world to a configured safe hub/spawn world before the reboot starts.

---

## 🎒 Smart Inventory Control
Decide whether players should keep their inventory or start completely fresh.

Items are only cleared **once** upon the first join into the new world — if players reconnect later, their inventory stays safe.

---

## ⌨️ Smart Tab Completion & Shortcuts
Full tab-completion support for commands, world names, and reboot options.

⚡ Use the shortcut:

```bash
/qwr <world>
```

to reboot worlds even faster.

---

## 🎨 Flexible World Styles
Generate worlds with different environments directly during reboot creation.

Supported styles:

- 🌍 `normal`
- 🔥 `nether`
- 🌌 `the_end`

---

## 🌱 Advanced Seed Management
Choose exactly how your new world should generate.

✅ Reuse the previous seed  
✅ Generate a completely random seed  
✅ Enter a custom seed manually  

---

## ⚙️ In-Game Hub Setup
Use:

```bash
/qwr setfallback
```

to instantly set your current location as the safe fallback location for all reboot teleports.

---

## 🚀 Lightweight & Reliable
Optimized for modern Minecraft versions with minimal server impact.

Includes a built-in **command fallback system** to ensure worlds are generated reliably even if advanced APIs fail.

---

## 🔒 Permission Support
Built-in permission support for administrators and staff members.

---

# 📋 Requirements

## ✅ Supported Server Software

- **Paper**
- **Purpur**

---

- **Tested on:** `1.21.x`

---

## ☕ Required Java Version
- **Java 21** or higher

---

## 🔧 Required Dependency
- **[Multiverse-Core](https://modrinth.com/plugin/multiverse-core)**

### Supported Versions
- **Multiverse-Core 4.x**
- **Multiverse-Core 5.x**

---

# 🛠️ Commands & Options

## `/qwr <world> [options...]`

Main reboot command *(Shortcut for `/qwr reboot`)*

### Available Options

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `style:normal/nether/the_end` | Change the world environment |
| `seed:<number>` | Use a custom seed |
| `reset-inv:true/false` | Clear inventory on first entry |
| `copy-seed:true/false` | Reuse the previous world's seed |
| `worldname:<text>` | Generate the world with a custom name |

---

## `/qwr setfallback`

Sets your current world and location as the safe fallback hub where players are teleported during world reboots.

---

## `/qwr report`

Get the Discord support link for bug reports and help.

---

## `/qwr debug`

Toggle live developer/debug messages directly in your chat.

---

# 🛠️ How It Works

1. 👥 **Safety Check**  
   Players inside the target world are moved to the configured hub/safe world.

2. 🗑️ **Deletion**  
   The old world files are safely removed.

3. 🌍 **Generation**  
   A completely fresh world is created using your selected style and seed settings.

4. 🚀 **Ready**  
   The world is instantly available for new adventures.
